sourcePatternScan.scope: Application/package/script source only; generated traces excluded. Raw source scan retained privately under .vsf.

manualEightAreas.xss: React escaped text and closed expression AST; Python user data embedded as UTF-8 hex JSON
manualEightAreas.secrets: Ephemeral nonextractable P256 private keys never stored/exported; no server credentials or env distribution
manualEightAreas.authorization: No account/server data; package acceptance requires independently trusted fingerprint and exact local-only permission
manualEightAreas.input: Bounded strict schema/engine/registry/hash/signature/size/depth validation; recompiled Python IR and manifest; late file and closed modal responses ignored
manualEightAreas.rate: No auth or paid API; local operation/time/state/record/source generation budgets
manualEightAreas.headersHttps: Final static manifest/security policies verified locally; public DNS/HTTPS unverified
manualEightAreas.serverDatabase: No server database; existing local IDB transactions/CAS/recovery regressions retained

Float64 numeric semantics including large integer-shaped input
